WITH global_avg AS (
    SELECT AVG("Year_working") AS avg_year FROM "employment"
),
company_avg AS (
    SELECT c."Company_ID", c."Name", AVG(e."Year_working") AS avg_year
    FROM "company" c
    JOIN "employment" e ON c."Company_ID" = e."Company_ID"
    WHERE c."Industry" = 'Oil and gas'
    GROUP BY c."Company_ID", c."Name"
)
SELECT ca."Name"
FROM company_avg ca, global_avg ga
WHERE ca.avg_year > ga.avg_year
ORDER BY ca.avg_year DESC
LIMIT 3;

INNER JOIN employment e ON c.Company_ID = e.Company_ID

LIMIT 3
